'''Corruption''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that was employed by users of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. It allowed a user of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to hurl a bolt of pure dark side energy.<ref name="TFU CG" />
